name: smwmusic-megami-tensei-gaiden-last-bible-ii-dungeon-last-bible-iii-remix
title: Megami Tensei Gaiden: Last Bible II - Dungeon (Last Bible III Remix)
description:
Last Bible II's dungeon theme, remastered to showcase the capability of Last Bible III's samples. Probably suitable for very intense levels and overworlds.

COMPATABILITY OPTION:
This song has a toggle option to set the echo level.
ECHO 2: works with #optimized.
ECHO 5: incompatible with Bonus End, Yoshi, and Thunder.
